## 📊 Weekly stats report
The n8n version of my Excel VBA macro, which turned a 3-hour weekly report into one click. Every Monday it reads 14 days of metrics from Supabase, totals each metric for this week and last week, works out the % change and emails a formatted report. Now it takes zero clicks.
